checks.description: Regenerated charter.freeze/2 from clean scratch clone at frozen HEAD: 135 entries and manifest SHA-256 bfc39c79a59621ac53933c34ebf87e4ccd5307c9c992956b78eeec4f7bd4c90b matched the supplied freeze record.
Required toolchain: exported PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; cargo --version reported 1.95.0 (f2d3ce0bd 2026-03-21).

Clean scratch clone host gate, rerun with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/holden-mcp-qa6-target-host-xtask and HOLDEN_TARGET_BASE=/tmp/holden-mcp-qa6-target-host-steps: cargo xtask gate slice-6. macOS/aarch64, frozen HEAD, clean tree; all steps and host guard passed, 65 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; result green. Each inner cargo invocation had its own target directory below the qa6 target prefix.

Linux/aarch64 gate on the VM using the frozen commit shipped as a Git bundle over SSH, with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/holden-mcp-qa6-target-linux-xtask and HOLDEN_TARGET_BASE=/tmp/holden-mcp-qa6-target-linux-steps. 65 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. Compared final host and Linux run records: the complete test arrays (names and statuses) are identical. Gate result red solely because cargo-deny, cargo-audit, and charter are unavailable on the VM; host covered all three successfully.

P1 positive and mutants: xtask::tests::forge_is_isolated passed. Added a path dependency from holden-canon (no holden-cognition crate exists at these frozen bytes) to holden-forge; the test failed naming both package and path dependency. Then added the reverse forge-to-holden-canon path dependency; the same test failed naming the outside path. Restored both manifests and lockfile; the test passed again.

P2 export reopen on macOS: exported 32 files to a fresh empty /tmp directory with the private denylist; cargo test --offline passed 13/13; forge verify passed; shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS passed every file. P2 absolute-home-path mutant refused and named methodology/BOOT-CONTRACT.md. P2 private identifier mutant refused and named methodology/BOOT-CONTRACT.md, reporting only denylist entry 6.
P2 export reopen on Linux/aarch64: fresh export from the Linux gate; cargo test --offline passed 13/13; forge verify passed; sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS passed every file.

P3 pack_validates, constitution_sections_trace_to_pack, deterministic_output, and roundtrip_lossless passed. Dropped the /pack_name derivation entry; constitution_sections_trace_to_pack failed with the missing pack pointer. Restored it; all 13 forge tests passed again.

P4 sums verification: changed methodology/BOOT-CONTRACT.md without updating SHA256SUMS; forge verify refused and named that file. Restored the exact file; forge verify passed. Verifier's own mutant: changed NOTICE; forge verify refused the unpinned NOTICE text and checksum. Restored it; verification passed.

Inspected host and Linux exports for parent repository name, user-home paths, temporary checkout paths, and machine address patterns; no matches. Final clean scratch host gate passed after all mutants were reverted.
